response.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) > (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals)) SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS mean_ownership_of_timings, AVG(avg_ownership) - (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals) AS average_excess_above_overall FROM timing_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Treat each eventannotm value, including NULL as its own group, equally when averaging qualifying group averages; the comparison baseline is the overall average institutional ownership across rows with non-NULL ownership.
